detail: List covers 28 states; an inverse 'Fewest major pro sports teams' ranking would be interesting for the many states with zero teams.
Covers all 50 states + DC; a 'smallest Asian population share' inverse (WV, MT, WY at bottom) would be a natural companion.
Covers 50+DC; inverse (lowest Black share — MT, ID, VT) is a natural companion.
Covers 50+DC monotonically; inverse (lowest veteran share — NY, NJ, DC at bottom) would be interesting.

Prompt is 'Largest wine production excluding California' — a competitive-friendly framing. Inverse phrasing 'Smallest wine production' would work well from the same data (DC 0.001M, AK 0.003M, WY 0.004M).

This question is the direct inverse of 'Wettest States (Most Annual Precipitation)'. Two lists over the same 51 jurisdictions with the same statewide-normal source produce essentially the same ranking reversed — one adds little independent play value beyond the other.

Direct inverse of 'Most Sunshine Hours Per Year' — same 51 jurisdictions, same NOAA Comparative Climatic Data source, same 30-year normals. Ranking is essentially the reverse of the sunshine list and provides limited independent play value.
